detail: Requested window starts 1985-01. FM02'STRACLUCON and FM02'STRECLUCON both start 1985/07. 1985-01 through 1985-06 were not backfilled. The official discount rate was not downloaded and was not substituted.
Daily uncollateralized overnight average on the BOJ time-series page starts 1998/01/05. 1985-01-01 through 1997-12-31 are absent. Not backfilled.

Tokyo Tanshi uncollateralized overnight month index returned HTTP 200. The year list on that page runs 2013 through 2026. No month link before 2013-01 was on the page, so it was not a source for 1985-2012 daily rates. Months after 2015-12 were not opened.
The correctly spelled historicaldata path returned HTTP 404. The live index is histricaldatas.html.
From 1998-01-05 through 2015-12-31 the vendor calendar has 2150 NA rows: 1876 weekend days and 274 weekdays. 2015-12-31 itself is NA. These rows were not stored and not backfilled.
The vendor monthly file has 129 months after 2015-12. Those rows were not written into the repository. Their values are not recorded here.
The vendor daily file has 3955 calendar rows after 2015-12-31. Those rows were not written into the repository. Their values are not recorded here.
Japanese monthly CSV was downloaded at 2026-11-03T18:07:09+08:00. Every in-window average and end-of-month string matched the English CSV. It was not used as the second source.
Japanese daily CSV was downloaded at 2026-11-03T18:07:09+08:00. Every cell from the first row through 2015-12-31 matched the English CSV, including NA. It was not used as the second source.
